structural_note: U_raw = (V'R/n)(R'V/n) with R of width 32, so rank(U) <= 32 and the utility matrix has at most 32 positive eigenvalues. Because the penalties are positive semidefinite, #positive(U - lambda P) <= 32 as well. r_plus can therefore only fall below 16 if a penalty drives more than 16 of U's 32 positive directions to or below zero.
scope_note: r_plus is the retained rank of the OLD fixed linear-moment matrix. It is not the optimal rank of the new nonlinear objective, which has no fixed matrix.
